description.value: Cafe Portrait is an art-filled brunch café on Denman Street in Vancouver's West End, where original oil paintings by the owner's father hang throughout a cozy, bohemian interior. The menu centres on made-to-order brunch dishes—Turkish eggs, shakshuka, smoked salmon benedict—alongside traditional Turkish coffee prepared tableside on hot sand and a full lineup of handcrafted cocktails. A pet-friendly patio and intimate indoor seating make it a relaxed stop in one of Vancouver's most cycle-accessible neighbourhoods.
